root_cause: A real GitHub workflow run reached OpenAI using the connected OPENAI_API_KEY, received structured content, then failed on a generated SEO meta description outside the required 120–170-character limit. Without bounded repair, the original long-form article never reaches the approved Notion stock.
intervention: When OpenAI returns SEO metadata outside the expected length, derive the corrected summary only from its original meta or the generated article introduction. Limit it on a word boundary, preserve all substantive article fields and run the full unchanged quality validator afterward. Reject unrepairable inputs.
prevention: Do not bypass the 900–1500-word article contract, human-approval governance, Notion stock deduplication, provider proof, translation gates or protected publishing chain.
